topic: What Is a Panel of Lenders and Why It Matters
objective: Explain the concept of a broker's lender panel and its practical significance.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A broker's panel is the group of lenders they have access to compare on your behalf. A broader, more varied panel — spanning banks, non-banks and specialist lenders — generally means a better chance of finding a genuine fit for your specific situation.

caption:
A broker's panel — the range of lenders they can actually compare on your behalf — is one of the more overlooked but important factors in choosing who to work with. A wider, more varied panel generally improves the odds of finding a facility that genuinely fits.

It's a completely fair question to ask upfront, and a transparent broker will answer it plainly.
